Real bug found live: a custom per-tenant Workday stage got ZERO processing

PwC's application flow has a stage literally named "Application Questions" — not one of the four hardcoded stage names (My Information / My Experience / Voluntary Disclosures / Self Identify) workday.js knows about. The observer used to bail out entirely whenever the current stage name wasn't a key in that map, before it ever reached the generic engine pass — so every field on any custom tenant-specific stage got literally no fill attempt at all, not even a best-effort one. This fixture simulates exactly that: a progress bar reporting an unrecognized stage name, with real recurring compliance questions on the page that should now get picked up by the generic pass regardless.
